channel.title: Auto Research Digest EN RSS
channel.description: A research publication on the design, approval, evaluation, and operation of LLMs, generative AI, and AI agents in real work.

item.title: Should LLMs replace every if statement? Understanding Jev’s decision API
item.description: Compare Jev with classifiers and structured LLM outputs. Understand Choice, Noul, Score, calibration, automated coverage, and the work that remains in code.

item.title: HACW: helping people and AI continue the same work
item.description: An HACW design hypothesis shares goals, versions, evidence, and decisions. Compare Workspace Agents, CLEO, Pista, and CHAP for joint work and handoffs.

item.title: When an AI request is hard to specify, start with something judgeable
item.description: Choose AI clarification or prototypes using writing, code, and image research. Make preferences specific, revise reviewable work, and verify completion.

item.title: Use AI agent evaluation to decide what work needs repair
item.description: Compare OpenAI, Google, AWS, and Anthropic agent evaluation through booking traces, tool order and arguments, saved results, and regression checks.

item.title: Delegating desktop work to AI: connect entry with verification
item.description: Compare AWS and Microsoft computer-use environments, a reported workflow, and long-task research to verify input, saves, recovery, and human effort.

item.title: Sales AI CRM updates: carry statements, forecasts, and agreements forward
item.description: Compare sales AI CRM operations through meeting evidence, statements versus forecasts, opportunity matching, concurrent updates, and human review effort.

item.title: AI-generated presentations: preserve the argument and the next edit
item.description: Compare AI presentation outlines, images, SVG, PPTX, and Google Slides. Choose formats through the argument, source evidence, and the recipient’s next edit.

item.title: What an agent platform takes responsibility for: five approaches to one business task
item.description: Compare five agent platforms through one ticket task: SDKs, execution, permissions, registries, evaluation, and the maintenance left to adopting teams.

item.title: Find an agent and trial it at work: five ecosystems and adoption decisions
item.description: Compare five agent ecosystems: app discovery, internal distribution and procurement. Turn listings into workplace trials for quality, access, cost and changes.

item.title: Carry an agent’s work into tomorrow: memory, artifacts, and recovery
item.description: Compare agent continuity across Codex, Agents SDK, Managed Agents, ADK and AgentCore: saved workspaces, artifact versions, stale memory and recovery checks.

item.title: Delegate one bug to a coding agent: from plan to a reviewable repair
item.description: Compare coding agents through one bug: plans, execution environments, permissions, diffs, tests, remote intervention, and the engineer’s review effort.

item.title: Agent memory design: why correct recall can still lead to the wrong decision
item.description: Compare agent memory beyond RAG: working state, durable preferences, shared updates, and forgetting, drawing on LangGraph, Letta, MemGPT, and LongMemEval.

item.title: Compare voice booking agents through corrections, interruption, and completion
item.description: Compare voice AI architectures, interruption, telephony, resumption, human handoff, and testing through whether spoken guidance matches the saved booking.

item.title: Delegating to subagents: turn completed research into usable decisions
item.description: Compare subagent designs across five vendors through model choice, parallel work, context, ordering, progress records, evidence handoffs, and human synthesis.

item.title: Connecting work with MCP, A2A, and AG-UI: what has finished?
item.description: Compare MCP, A2A 1.0, and AG-UI through a refund workflow: task completion, interface events, disconnection, and cancellation.

item.title: Compare video AI through revision: references, sound, and editing
item.description: Compare video AI references, audio, footage modification, and editing. Examine versions, limitations, and the work needed for an acceptable revision.

item.title: Agent identity and user delegation: whose access is granted, and where it ends
item.description: Compare agent identity, delegated access, and MCP authorization. Trace revocation and retained information while preserving necessary work.

item.title: Meeting preparation with Cowork: connecting evidence, analysis, and action
item.description: Compare Cowork for meeting preparation: context, Excel and PowerPoint, computer use, and changes across artifacts. Include human review when judging value.

item.title: AI chat UI: when to add an editor or a visible plan
item.description: Compare AI chat UI, Canvas, Pages, and Artifacts. Examine Cocoa’s controlled study and the Keyhole Effect theory to decide when to add editing, plans, or forms.

item.title: Agent security: trace external instructions through to execution
item.description: Evaluate agent security through prompt-injection detection, authorization, communication limits, human review, and tests of permitted and prohibited actions.
